summary: Built an automated AWS Kiro update scraper/watcher system. Created scrapers for 6 official AWS channels (AWS Blog, Kiro product page, Kiro docs, Kiro changelog, AWS YouTube, AWS What's New). Implemented first-party-only content filtering (aws.amazon.com, kiro.dev, docs.aws.amazon.com, youtube.com domains). Built a serverless API endpoint (api/scrape-kiro.js) that fetches pages and extracts Kiro-related items via HTML parsing and JSON-LD extraction. Added storage layer for persisting scraped items and scan history. Created a KiroUpdates UI component with scan controls, source monitoring list, scraped items display, newsletter preview/compose, and scan history. Integrated into the app navigation as a new 'kiro' tab.
